english: Beyond this point, only those TRAINERS\nwho have collected all the GYM BADGES\lare permitted to enter.\pTRAINER, let us confirm that you have\nall the GYM BADGES.
dutch: Hierna mogen alleen TRAINERS die\nalle GYM BADGES hebben, verder.\pTRAINER, we controleren of je\nalle GYM BADGES hebt.

english: You haven't obtained all the BADGES.\pIf you're bound for the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you must return with them.
dutch: Je hebt niet alle BADGES.\pWil je naar de POKéMON LEAGUE,\ndan kom je terug met alle BADGES.

english: TRAINER! Believe in yourself and your\nPOKéMON, and go forth!
dutch: TRAINER! Geloof in jezelf en je\nPOKéMON, en ga verder!
